description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer newline/index checkpoint: safe Rust owns LF/IND/NEL viewport panning, physical-bottom scrolling, DECSTBM confinement, DECSLRM rectangular scrolling, carriage-return column semantics and standard-erase fill attributes.

entries.notes: Repeated LF under DECSTBM uses the existing vertical-scroll owner and keeps every affected cell in default non-legacy Rust attributes, preserving symbolic default foreground/background colors while the margin region scrolls.
LF from the visible bottom pans the viewport one row into existing buffer space, keeps the cursor on the new visible bottom, and standard-erases the newly exposed row from the active attributes.

After LF reaches the physical buffer bottom, further LF scrolls the visible region in place, keeps the cursor at the bottom cell row, preserves prior default rows and standard-erases the newly revealed bottom row with active colors.

Without DECSTBM, LF at viewport bottom pans into scrollback; with a vertical margin active and the cursor below its lower edge, LF remains confined to the viewport and neither cursor nor viewport pans past the visible bottom.

IND and NEL match Microsoft's top-of-viewport, bottom-pan, DECSTBM lower-edge and DECSTBM+DECSLRM rectangular-scroll cases. IND preserves the column; NEL returns to column zero or the active left horizontal margin, and revealed cells use the active standard-erase attributes.
